To get to House of Rainbow you turn off the Apata Road from Ibadan at the Moco petrol station and you make your way down a rutted track through a cluttered market. Ibadan is Yoruba heartland, the region’s commercial hub and the home of what was once Africa’s most illustrious university. Here, on Ibadan’s western fringes, shanty-commerce rubs against gated residential compounds, and at the end of the track you enter one of these: three buildings, in various stages of distress, around a car park.
